'''Hydrostatic bubbles''' were bioengineered by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to construct underwater cities such as [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

==Description==
Hydrostatic bubble technology was developed by the Gungans when they were forced underwater by the [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmalltian]] [[colonist]]s who dominated [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The bubble functioned by projecting a membrane-field which displaced water and prevented the entry of foreign objects through the bubble's except at specific entry portals.<ref name="NoP" /> The base of each bubble was comprised of a lightweight alloy lattice and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] that contained the bubble's generator. Varying in size, the average-sized bubbles were projected by utanodes; while larger versions were generated by a kernode assembly.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Episode I" /> The underside of the base consisted of a long, pointed spire where counterweights and [[Hydrostatic Field Generator|repulsor field generators]] worked to keep the bubble upright and stable.<ref name="NoP" />

The evolution of the technology eventually saw it adapted for use in [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|vehicles]] and military shields.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'', they are referred to as '''hydrostatic force field bubbles'''.
